analyst.summary: WeWork India runs profitable, fast-growing co-working centres, but the stock trades at a very rich level (around 116x earnings and 34x book value) after borrowings rose sharply, from about Rs 310 crore to Rs 5,550 crore, to fund expansion. Quarterly profit has also swung from a healthy gain to a small loss on similar underlying operations, and promoters have pledged over a third of their stake. The growth story is real, but the price and the new leverage leave little room for error, so we rate this a Sell.
